headline: Malaysia Q3 GDP Expands 5.5%, Beating Estimates on Tech Exports
summary: Malaysia's economy grew 5.5% year-on-year in the third quarter, surpassing advance government and analyst estimates of 5.3%, propelled by sustained domestic consumption and tech exports.
why: Malaysia is an integral node in the global semiconductor assembly and testing supply chain. Outperforming growth underpins the ringgit and sovereign debt.

impacts.name: FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI
impacts.why: Third-quarter GDP expansion exceeding forecasts reinforces corporate earnings outlooks.
